headline: Evaluate strategic setup moves without changing campaign difficulty

changes.title: Test deliberate nonmatching setup moves inside engine-backed lookahead
changes.detail: The diagnostic planner now considers up to two legal nonmatching swaps that may build better next-turn matches, then checks the consequences through actual engine simulation. Setup moves still consume daily moves and cannot fabricate points.

changes.title: Measure setup-aware planning against the original match-only planner
changes.detail: Identical late-stage seeds and search budgets now compare the objective bot, match-only three-turn search, setup-aware search, and a separate limited-Hammer variant. Reports count both setup candidates evaluated and setup moves actually selected.

changes.title: Verify candidate legality, deterministic branch isolation, and reproducible reporting
changes.detail: New diagnostic assertions confirm setup moves do not immediately score, undo speculative tile changes, retain the random stream, and remain within strict per-turn limits. Documentation explains the bounded-search limitations.
